name: חַכְמוֹנִי
summary: The father of Jehiel, who was with the king's sons among David's officers (1Ch 27:32). The same spelling names the family of Jashobeam, chief of David's mighty men, “son of a Hachmonite” (1Ch 11:11), called the Tahchemonite in 2Sa 23:8. The name is the adjective חָכָם “wise” with the ending -ônî.

evidence.note: “Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons.”
“Jashobeam, son of a Hachmonite, chief of the thirty.”
חָכָם “wise”, the word the name is formed from.

note: Takes h.cg.ad (2 tokens, 1Ch 11:11 and 27:32); TIPNR keys 1Ch 11:11 to the group Hachmonites@2Sa.23.8, which is not a person and so is not listed in people. The meaning “wise” rests on the form alone; whether Hachmon is a place (as TIPNR suggests) is not settled by the text.
